questions.stem:
A matrix is given below. Each letter is coded by its (Row, Column) position.

         Col-0  Col-1  Col-2  Col-3  Col-4
Row-0:     E      A      M      K      O
Row-1:     N      D      B      L      S
Row-2:     T      G      H      R      I
Row-3:     F      U      P      C      J
Row-4:     W      V      Q      X      Y

What is the code for the letter 'A'?
questions.explanation: B is correct. 'A' is at Row-0, Col-1 → code = 01. 'E' is at 00; 'N' is at 10; 'D' is at 11. In matrix coding, always read Row first, then Column.

questions.stem:
(Same matrix as Q1)

What is the code for the letter 'T'?
questions.explanation: B is correct. 'T' is at Row-2, Col-0 → code = 20. Trap: 02 is 'M' (Row-0, Col-2); 22 is 'H'; 30 is 'F'. Always check row first.

questions.stem:
(Same matrix as Q1)

What word is coded by: 30  10  24  00?
questions.explanation: A is correct. Decode each: 30=F (Row3,Col0), 10=N (Row1,Col0), 24=I (Row2,Col4), 00=E (Row0,Col0) → F-N-I-E = FINE. Trap: MINE would require M=02 at position 1; LINE needs L=13; DINE needs D=11.

questions.stem:
(Same matrix as Q1)

What is the code for the word 'MAN'?
questions.explanation: B is correct. M=02 (Row0,Col2), A=01 (Row0,Col1), N=10 (Row1,Col0) → 02-01-10. Trap: 02-00-10 codes for M-E-N (MEn); 12-01-10 codes B-A-N (BAN).

questions.stem:
(Same matrix as Q1)

What is the code for the word 'BORN'?
questions.explanation: A is correct. B=12 (Row1,Col2), O=04 (Row0,Col4), R=23 (Row2,Col3), N=10 (Row1,Col0) → 12-04-23-10. Trap: 12-04-23-00 ends in E (not N); 12-40-23-10 uses 40=W (not O); 21-04-23-10 starts with G (not B).

A is correct. 04=O, 23=R, 12=B, 24=I, 20=T → ORBIT. Verify: O=Row0,Col4 ✓; R=Row2,Col3 ✓; B=Row1,Col2 ✓; I=Row2,Col4 ✓; T=Row2,Col0 ✓. Trap: ORBIN would need N=10 at the end; OKBIT would need K=03 at position 2.

questions.stem:
(Same matrix as Q1)

What is the code for the word 'CAMP'?
questions.explanation: A is correct. C=33 (Row3,Col3), A=01 (Row0,Col1), M=02 (Row0,Col2), P=32 (Row3,Col2) → 33-01-02-32. Trap: 33-01-02-23 ends in R (not P); 33-00-02-32 uses 00=E (not A); 23-01-02-32 starts with R (not C).

questions.stem:
(Same matrix as Q1)

If 'BIRD' is coded as 12-24-23-11, what is the code for 'BILL'?
questions.explanation: A is correct. Verify BIRD: B=12, I=24, R=23, D=11 ✓. BILL: B=12, I=24, L=13 (Row1,Col3), L=13 → 12-24-13-13. Trap: 12-24-11-11 codes BIDD; 12-24-13-14 codes BILS (14=S); 12-21-13-13 codes BGLL.

B is correct. 31=U (Row3,Col1), 14=S (Row1,Col4), 22=H (Row2,Col2), 00=E (Row0,Col0), 23=R (Row2,Col3), 14=S → USHERS. Trap: URGERS would need G (21) at position 3 instead of H (22); UTTERS needs T (20) repeatedly.

questions.stem:
(Same matrix as Q1)

What is the code for the word 'GHOST'?
questions.explanation: A is correct. G=21 (Row2,Col1), H=22 (Row2,Col2), O=04 (Row0,Col4), S=14 (Row1,Col4), T=20 (Row2,Col0) → 21-22-04-14-20. Trap: option B ends in 02=M (not T); option C uses 40=W (not O); option D uses 24=I instead of S.
